verdict.rationale: On the Claude API, Skills run inside the code execution environment via the `container` parameter (docs-10), which implies an isolated runtime. Plugin skills can also be tested locally with the `--plugin-dir` flag before distribution (docs-41), and skill-creator can benchmark skills (docs-14). None of this explicitly describes a sandbox that keeps production data out of reach. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the execution container is a sandbox isolated from production data/systems, a documented staging or test-environment workflow for skills, and independent or hands-on corroboration of isolation.
